summary: Improve lease controls, service-charge checks and property evidence practices. Explore this practical five-day training course.
lede: Training in property legal obligations covers interpreting lease terms, checking service-charge calculations and maintaining evidence for decisions. For property managers, lease administrators and facilities leads, it develops practical skills in building obligation schedules, reviewing digital lease records, checking reconciliations, mapping contractor responsibilities and documenting notices and dispute escalation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who administer leases, oversee property operations or produce the records used to support property decisions.
prerequisites: Working experience in property, facilities or lease administration is expected. Familiarity with lease records is useful; no coding or programming is required.
